notes: Item 19 discloses three sets of tables for the 2024 calendar year: (1) all Pretzelmaker restaurants (103 units, includes co-branded), (2) co-branded Pretzelmaker+Great American Cookies restaurants (19 units), and (3) standalone Pretzelmaker-only restaurants (84 units). Each set reports Net Sales (Table 1), Range of Net Sales (Table 2), Food Cost % (Table 3), and Labor Cost % (Table 4), broken down by location type (Total, In-Line: Mall, In-Line: Off Mall, Other, End-Cap). End-Cap rows have zero units across all sets and are omitted from records. Table 2 Range of Net Sales rows are not separately captured as individual records since they are distribution buckets rather than cohort-level averages/medians. The disclosed data is unaudited and omits all operating costs except food, paper, and store-level labor. The cohort_name 'other' is used for the co-branded and standalone sub-groups as no schema value precisely matches these format-based segments. The 'all_franchised' cohort_name is used for the first set of tables (all Pretzelmaker restaurants) as it is the broadest franchised cohort. The #/% >=Avg column for Net Sales and <=Avg for cost percentages is captured in pct_above_avg where applicable (for net sales, >=avg is the natural interpretation for pct_above_avg; for cost %, <=avg means performing at or better than average cost, which is also noted).
